name: Hailo-15H AI Vision Processor product brief (Hailo, 01/2026)
notes: SoC brief gives only the DRAM interface: 'LPDDR4/4X 32bit @4266 MT/s'. 17.1 GB/s is derived (4266 MT/s x 32 bit / 8); capacity is system-defined, 8 GB is the maximum fitted on the SolidRun Hailo-15 SoM (Hailo-15H variant, 'up to 8Gbyte LPDDR4', default 4 GB). Hailo publishes no chip-level capacity or bandwidth figure.
